description:
This image is a screenshot of a web-based user interface within the EAGLE Data Catalogue, showing the details for a data extraction named 'ES616_roads' in 'DRAFT' status. The top navigation bar includes links for "Data Catalogue", "EAGLE Ontology", "About EAGLE", "Organisations", and "Users", along with a "CLC+ Core User Admin/Support" user profile.

The page header displays "Data Catalogue / Extraction 'ES616_roads'" with actions "REPUBLISH ON GEOSERVER", "START EXTRACTION", and "PUBLISH". A left panel titled "General Information" provides metadata:
- Name: ES616_roads
- Country: Spain/España
- Region: Jaén
- Reference Year: -
- Time Range of Extracted Data: -
- INSPIRE Themes: [unreadable icon link]
- Resolution: 10 m
- Created By: CLC+ Core User Admin/Support
- Organisation/s: CLC (Copernicus Land Monitoring Service) and European Environment Agency (EEA)
An "EDIT" button is present next to the "General Information" title.

The right panel shows an interactive map or preview area with selected filters for "Country*: ES Spain/España" and "Region*: ES616 Jaén". A "PREVIEW" button is available. The map area is blurred and displays a message: "Your map is outdated! Please press "PREVIEW" to generate the map according to your new input", along with a refresh icon. Below this, there is an expandable section titled "Input Classes" which appears to be an empty input field outlined by a dashed border, with a plus icon to add classes.
